github.description: GitHub operations (PRs, issues, repos) via the official remote server. The old npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is unsupported as of 2025-04. PAT: github.com/settings/tokens

context7.description: Live documentation lookup — use with documentation-lookup skill (resolve-library-id, query-docs).

exa.description: Web search and research via Exa — broader research after GitHub search and primary docs.

brave-search.description: Independent web/local search (complements exa). Free tier 2,000 queries/mo: api.search.brave.com/app/keys

sentry.description: Sentry errors/issues via remote OAuth (no plaintext key). Approve on first session; OAuth flow via /mcp.

time.description: Current time + IANA timezone conversion. Requires uv (brew install uv).

playwright.description: Headless browser automation and testing. Use --extension instead to drive a running browser.

agent-browser.description: Vercel Agent Browser official MCP (stdio, core tools profile) — semantic selectors, AI-optimized, built on Playwright. Requires: npm install -g agent-browser && agent-browser install. Use --tools all for full CLI parity.

higgsfield.description: Higgsfield AI image/video generation (30+ models: Soul, Kling, Veo, Flux, Seedream). Remote OAuth — no API key in config; authenticate with your Higgsfield account on first use.

zapier.description: Zapier MCP — 9,000+ app integrations, 40,000+ actions. Remote OAuth; sign in at mcp.zapier.com when prompted. Claude Code plugin alt: /plugin install zapier@claude-plugins-official.

_comments.usage: Copy the servers you need into the project .mcp.json or ~/.claude.json mcpServers section
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders. The committed .mcp.json uses ${VAR} env refs instead of literals — prefer that for shared files.
_comments.context_warning: Keep under 10 MCPs enabled to preserve context window
